title: gamochaeta ustulata
intro: Gamochaeta ustulata, commonly known as Redstem Gamochaeta, is a plant species that belongs to the daisy family, Asteraceae. It is known for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Gamochaeta ustulata include its ability to treat wounds, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
